title: Enriched inversion commutes with a cartesian parameter
statement:
Use small simplicial categories, Dwyer--Kan equivalences, the model homotopy category $h\mathrm{sCat}$ and the derived pushout localization $q:C\to L_WC$ of [lem-coef-simplicial-inversion-universal-property]. For small simplicial categories $C,D$, their cartesian product has objects $(c,d)$, mapping sets $C(c,c')\times D(d,d')$, and componentwise composition and identities. Let $W$ be a set of vertex arrows of $C$, and put $W_D=\{(w,1_d):w\in W,\ d\in\operatorname{Ob}D\}$. Then the map $q\times1_D$ induces an isomorphism in $h\mathrm{sCat}$
$$L_{W_D}(C\times D)\longrightarrow (L_WC)\times D.$$
For any representative of this derived comparison it is a Dwyer--Kan equivalence. The comparison is natural for enriched functors in both variables preserving the specified arrows. No fibrancy assumption on $C,D$ or saturation assumption on $W$ is imposed; universes contain all the displayed categories.
